name: DUMBBELL TOE-TOUCH CRUNCH RIGHT
introduce:
Lie on your back with your right arm raised up and hold a dumbbell in your right hand. 

Put your left arm on the ground at your side. Bend your right leg and keep your left leg straight on the ground. 

Raise your shoulders and left leg up to make your left foot touch the dumbbell. Then lower them back and repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Please prepare a dumbbell and a mat.
Please squeeze your core as hard as you can when you raise up.
Please keep the lifted leg straight.
Please make sure your upper back leaves the ground when you raise up.
It works on your rectus abdominus, obilques and shoulders.
